domains.name: production
domains.description: Core manufacturing execution domain governing shop floor control, work orders, routing, scheduling, WIP tracking, cycle time, takt time, throughput, and OEE. Integrates with MES (Siemens Opcenter) and ERP (SAP PP) to orchestrate production runs, machine assignments, capacity planning, and shift-level output reporting via SCADA/DCS systems.

products.name: production_work_order
products.description: Core manufacturing work order representing a discrete production job issued to the shop floor. Authorizes manufacture of a specific quantity of finished or semi-finished goods by linking a routing, BOM revision, and production version. Tracks planned vs. actual dates, priority, order status, WIP value, and completion percentage. The SSOT for all production execution activity within this domain. Sourced from ERP production orders (e.g., SAP PP) and MES work order management (e.g., Siemens Opcenter).
products.reference: SAP PP Production Order / Siemens Opcenter Work Order

attributes.name: planned_quantity

attributes.name: planned_start_date

attributes.name: priority_code

attributes.name: production_notes

attributes.name: release_date

attributes.name: scrap_quantity

attributes.name: scrap_rate_percentage

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Actual time in minutes required to set up equipment and tooling before production begins.
attributes.references: SAP PP Setup Time, Siemens Opcenter MES Changeover Time

attributes.name: standard_cost

attributes.name: takt_time_minutes

attributes.name: work_order_number

attributes.references: SAP PP Production Order, Siemens Opcenter MES Work Order

attributes.references: Siemens Opcenter MES Order Status, SAP PP System Status

attributes.name: work_order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work order by production purpose: standard production, rework, prototype, maintenance, or sample run.

attributes.name: yield_rate_percentage

attributes.references: OEE Quality Component, SAP PP Yield

products.name: order_confirmation
products.description: Shop floor confirmation record capturing actual production output reported against a work order operation. Records confirmed yield quantity, scrap quantity, rework quantity, actual labor hours, machine hours, and operator ID. Represents the operation-level goods receipt event and drives actual vs. planned variance analysis for cost settlement and performance monitoring. Sourced from ERP order confirmations (e.g., SAP CO11N/CO15) and MES activity reporting (e.g., Siemens Opcenter).

attributes.name: order_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for order_confirmation

attributes.name: failure_record_id

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Confirmation-to-invoice reconciliation: in manufacturing, each production order confirmation (goods movement) must be matched to the invoice raised for that output. This direct FK enables billing audi

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_revision. This supports regulatory compliance, warranty claims, and field

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Order confirmations must be tied to the SKU to report actual yield, scrap, and cost per product.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: Order confirmations post goods movements (goods_movement_type column present). The stock location for goods issue/receipt is required for material document posting in ERP. storage_location_code is a d

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (production resource) where this operation was performed. Links to the work center master data defining capacity, cost center, and resource type.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The cost accounting activity type for this confirmation (e.g., machine setup, machine run, manual labor, quality inspection). Used for activity-based costing and rate calculation.

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: The actual cost amount incurred for this confirmation based on actual quantities and actual rates. Used for variance analysis and profitability reporting.

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours
attributes.description: The total labor hours consumed for this operation confirmation. Used for labor cost calculation and efficiency analysis against standard or planned hours.

attributes.name: actual_machine_hours
attributes.description: The total machine runtime hours consumed for this operation confirmation. Used for machine cost allocation and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 Key Performance Indicators for Manufacturing Operations Management

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the confirmation transaction. Externally visible confirmation document number generated by ERP (SAP CO11N/CO15) or MES system.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the confirmation record indicating whether it is in draft, submitted for approval, posted to inventory and cost accounting, reversed due to error, or cancelled.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the production activity was confirmed on the shop floor. Represents the actual business event time of goods receipt or operation completion.

attributes.name: confirmation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the confirmation transaction indicating whether it represents a final completion, partial progress, automatic backflush, milestone achievement, rework activity, or scrap reporting.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that created this confirmation record. Used for audit trail and accountability in production reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this confirmation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this confirmation record. Typically the plant or company code currency.

attributes.name: final_confirmation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this confirmation represents the final completion of the operation. When true, the operation is closed for further confirmations and the work order may proceed to the next operation or completion.

attributes.name: goods_movement_type
attributes.description: The inventory movement type code triggered by this confirmation (e.g., 101 for goods receipt, 261 for goods issue, 531 for scrap). Aligns with ERP goods movement transaction codes.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that last modified this confirmation record. Used for audit trail and change accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this confirmation record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The material document number generated in ERP inventory management when this confirmation posted goods movements. Used for reconciliation between production and inventory systems.

attributes.name: mes_transaction_code
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier from the source MES system (e.g., Siemens Opcenter) that originated this confirmation. Used for system integration reconciliation and traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 Key Performance Indicators for Manufacturing Operations Management

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: The specific operation sequence number within the work order routing for which this confirmation is recorded. Identifies the production step (e.g., 0010, 0020, 0030) in the manufacturing process.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or production facility code where this confirmation was recorded. Used for multi-site reporting and cost center assignment.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the confirmation was posted to inventory and financial ledgers. Used for period-based cost settlement and variance analysis.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether the output from this confirmation requires quality inspection before it can be released to inventory or the next operation. Drives inspection lot creation in QM module.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this confirmation is a reversal of a previously posted confirmation. Used to correct errors and maintain audit trail of production reporting changes.

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of output that requires rework or reprocessing due to quality issues. Tracked separately from scrap to measure process capability and rework costs.

attributes.name: scada_event_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Event ID
attributes.description: Reference to the SCADA system event or data collection record that triggered or validated this confirmation. Used for automated confirmation workflows and real-time monitoring integration.

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Event ID

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of defective or non-conforming output that was scrapped during this operation. Used for scrap rate calculation and variance analysis.

attributes.name: serial_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of serial numbers for serialized output units produced in this confirmation. Used for unit-level traceability in high-value or regulated products.

attributes.name: setup_time_hours
attributes.description: The time spent on machine setup, changeover, and preparation activities before production started. Tracked separately from run time for SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 Key Performance Indicators for Manufacturing Operations Management

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system for this confirmation record (ERP for SAP PP, MES for Siemens Opcenter, SCADA for Aveva, MANUAL for manual entry). Used for data lineage and integration monitoring.

attributes.name: standard_cost_amount
attributes.description: The standard cost amount for this confirmation based on planned quantities and standard rates. Used as the baseline for variance calculation in cost accounting.

attributes.name: teardown_time_hours
attributes.description: The time spent on machine teardown, cleanup, and post-production activities after the operation completed. Used for total cycle time calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 Key Performance Indicators for Manufacturing Operations Management

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for all quantity fields in this confirmation (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, L for liters, M for meters). Must align with the material master UOM.

attributes.name: variance_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments explaining variances, quality issues, or other notable events during the operation. Provides context for exception analysis and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) investigations.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for any variance between planned and actual quantities or times. Used for root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: yield_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of good output produced and confirmed for this operation. Represents conforming units that passed quality inspection and are available for subsequent operations or finished goods inventory.

products.name: schedule
products.description: Master production schedule (MPS) record defining planned production quantities, start/finish dates, and shift assignments for a given production item across a planning horizon. Tracks schedule version, freeze horizon, planning bucket (daily/weekly), and schedule status (draft, released, frozen, revised). Represents the output of APS/MRP II scheduling runs. Sourced from ERP production planning (e.g., SAP PP) and APS systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain).

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bill of materials used for this scheduled production. Defines the material components and structure.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Production schedules in make-to-order manufacturing are directly tied to customer accounts for ATP (Available-to-Promise) reporting and customer-facing delivery commitment management. Planners need to

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Associates production schedule with the plant location to enable plant‑level capacity planning and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or product being scheduled for production.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.mrp_run. Business justification: MRP-driven scheduling: production schedules are generated by MRP runs. Schedulers must know which MRP run produced each schedule to manage re-planning cycles, respond to exception messages, and audit

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.line. Business justification: MRP demand pegging links production schedule requirements to specific sales order lines. This enables pegging reports showing which production schedule covers which order line demand — a standard MRP/

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production routing or process plan used for this schedule. Defines the sequence of operations and work centers.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Master production schedules are created per SKU; linking enables MPS reporting and demand planning.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: MRP scheduling assigns planned output to a target stock location (finished goods staging). Capacity and inventory planning reports require knowing which stock location receives scheduled production ou

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production line assigned to execute this schedule.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule requires management approval before release. True for high-value, high-risk, or exception schedules; false for routine schedules.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule was cancelled. Null if the schedule was not cancelled.

attributes.name: capacity_requirement_hours
attributes.description: Total machine or labor hours required to complete this schedule. Used for capacity planning and load leveling.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when production for this schedule was completed. Used for schedule performance analysis and cycle time measurement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and schedule age analysis.

attributes.name: firmed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is firmed (locked) and should not be automatically rescheduled by planning systems. True means the schedule is manually controlled; false means it can be adjusted by MRP/APS.

attributes.name: freeze_horizon_date
attributes.description: Date beyond which this schedule is frozen and cannot be changed without formal approval. Protects near-term execution from planning volatility.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule record was last updated. Tracks schedule volatility and planning changes.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total lead time from schedule release to completion, including queue time, setup, run, and move time. Used for order promising and planning.

attributes.name: lot_size_quantity
attributes.description: Standard lot or batch size for this production schedule. May be driven by economic order quantity, equipment constraints, or process requirements.

attributes.name: lot_sizing_rule
attributes.description: Algorithm used to determine production lot sizes. Fixed lot uses a constant quantity; lot-for-lot matches demand exactly; EOQ optimizes ordering costs; POQ aggregates demand over periods.

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRP controller or planner responsible for this schedule. Used for accountability and workload distribution.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from planners regarding special instructions, constraints, or considerations for this schedule.

attributes.name: pegging_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the demand source (sales order, forecast, safety stock) that this schedule is pegged to. Enables traceability from supply to demand.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Target quantity of the material to be produced according to this schedule. Expressed in the base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: planning_bucket
attributes.description: Time granularity of the schedule planning horizon. Daily for short-term detailed scheduling, weekly for medium-term planning, monthly for long-term capacity planning.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_weeks
attributes.description: Number of weeks into the future that this schedule covers. Defines the forward visibility window for production planning.

attributes.name: planning_strategy
attributes.description: Manufacturing strategy governing how this schedule is planned and executed. Make-to-stock builds for inventory; make-to-order builds against customer orders; assemble-to-order configures from standard components; engineer-to-order designs and builds custom products.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Relative priority of this schedule compared to other schedules. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for resource allocation and sequencing decisions.

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule was released for execution. Marks the transition from planning to active production.

attributes.name: run_time_hours
attributes.description: Estimated time required to produce the planned quantity, excluding setup and teardown. Used for cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock quantity maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Influences schedule timing and quantities.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the production schedule. Externally visible schedule reference number used in planning and execution systems.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production schedule. Draft schedules are under planning; released schedules are active; frozen schedules are locked for execution; revised schedules have been updated; cancelled schedules are voided; completed schedules are finished.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the schedule by planning level. MPS for top-level finished goods; FAS for final assembly operations; RCCP for high-level capacity validation; MRP for detailed component planning.

attributes.name: scheduled_finish_date
attributes.description: Planned date when production for this schedule is expected to be completed. Used for order promising and delivery planning.

attributes.name: scheduled_finish_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when production execution is scheduled to finish, used for detailed capacity loading and sequencing.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date when production for this schedule is expected to begin. Key input for capacity planning and material availability checks.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when production execution is scheduled to start, including shift and time-of-day information for detailed shop floor scheduling.

attributes.name: setup_time_hours
attributes.description: Estimated time required to set up equipment and tooling before production can begin. Part of total lead time calculation.

attributes.name: shift_assignment
attributes.description: Shift during which this production schedule is assigned to run. Used for labor planning and shift-level capacity allocation.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: System or process that generated this schedule. MRP run for material requirements planning; APS optimization for advanced planning and scheduling; manual planning for planner-created schedules; demand forecast for forecast-driven schedules; customer order for order-driven schedules.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the planned quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, L for liters, M for meters).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the schedule. Incremented each time the schedule is revised or replanned.

products.name: work_center
products.description: Master data entity representing a physical or logical production resource on the shop floor — a machine, assembly cell, production line segment, or labor group — at which manufacturing operations are performed. Captures work center code, plant, cost center linkage, capacity category, available capacity per shift, efficiency rate, utilization rate, and OEE baseline target. The SSOT for capacity planning and routing assignments within the production domain. Sourced from ERP work center master (e.g., SAP CR01).

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work center. Primary key.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.location. Business justification: A work center belongs to a work center group; adding work_center_group_id creates the parent relationship and eliminates the need for ad‑hoc grouping logic.

attributes.name: production_plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this work center is located.

attributes.name: available_capacity_per_shift
attributes.description: Standard available capacity of the work center per shift, measured in the capacity category unit.

attributes.name: capacity_category
attributes.description: Unit of measure for capacity planning (e.g., machine hours, labor hours, throughput units).

attributes.name: capacity_planning_group
attributes.description: Grouping code for aggregating work centers in capacity planning and leveling activities.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Classification of the work center type indicating the nature of the production resource.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the work center used in ERP and MES systems. Externally-known unique code for capacity planning and routing assignments.

attributes.name: control_key
attributes.description: Control key defining how operations are processed at this work center (e.g., internal processing, external processing, inspection).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: efficiency_rate_percent
attributes.description: Standard efficiency rate of the work center expressed as a percentage, representing the ratio of actual output to theoretical maximum output.

attributes.name: formula_key

products.name: routing
products.description: Manufacturing routing master defining the ordered sequence of operations required to produce a finished or semi-finished item. Captures routing number, routing type (production, inspection, universal), base quantity, status, and validity dates. Each routing is composed of individual operations (modeled as line items) linked to work centers with standard times for setup, machine run, and labor. The SSOT for standard production process definitions. Sourced from ERP routing master (e.g., SAP CA01) and PLM process plans (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter).
products.reference: SAP PP Routing (CA01) / PLM Process Plan

attributes.name: routing_id

attributes.name: bom_id

attributes.name: eco_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.eco. Business justification: Routings are created or revised when an ECO is implemented (new operations, changed tooling, updated cycle times). Linking routing to the triggering ECO supports engineering change management workflow

attributes.name: engineering_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_specification. IATF 16949 and AS9100 require routings to reference governing engineering s

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or finished good that this routing produces. Links to the material master in inventory domain.

attributes.name: product_bom_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.bom_header. Business justification: Routing-BOM pairing for production recipe management: in manufacturing (SAP/ERP standard), a routing is always paired with a product BOM header to form the complete production recipe. This link enable

attributes.description: FK to production.production_line

attributes.name: production_plant_id
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility where this routing is executed. Links to plant master data.

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_revision. When an engineering revision changes operation sequences or tooling, the routing must referen

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this routing was approved for production use.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the routing. Pending routings await review; approved routings are authorized for production; rejected routings require rework; under_review routings are in the approval workflow.

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: Standard lot size or batch quantity for which the routing times and resource requirements are defined. All operation times are calculated relative to this base quantity.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the base quantity. Standard ISO unit codes such as EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), M (meter).

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: Engineering Change Notice (ECN) or Engineering Change Order (ECO) number that authorized the creation or last modification of this routing. Supports traceability of process changes.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard cost amount.

attributes.name: counter
attributes.description: Sequential counter within the routing group. Together with routing_group, forms an alternative business key.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this routing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the routing purpose, scope, and special instructions. Provides context for production planners and shop floor operators.

attributes.name: is_default_routing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this routing is the default routing for the material. True if this is the primary routing; false if it is an alternative.

attributes.name: is_phantom_routing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a phantom routing that is automatically consumed without generating a separate production order. Used for subassemblies that are immediately incorporated into parent assemblies.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_used_date

attributes.name: lot_size_from
attributes.description: Minimum lot size for which this routing is applicable. Supports lot-size-dependent routing selection.

attributes.name: lot_size_to
attributes.description: Maximum lot size for which this routing is applicable. Null indicates no upper limit.

attributes.name: planner_group
attributes.description: Production planning team or planner responsible for maintaining and scheduling this routing.

attributes.name: routing_group
attributes.description: Grouping code for related routings. Used to organize routings by product family, process type, or manufacturing cell.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the routing. Externally visible routing code used in production planning and shop floor documentation.

attributes.name: routing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the routing. Draft routings are under development; released routings are approved for use; active routings are currently in production; inactive routings are temporarily suspended; obsolete routings are retired; blocked routings are prohibited from use.

attributes.name: routing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the routing purpose. Production routings define standard manufacturing sequences; inspection routings define quality check sequences; rework routings define repair processes; universal routings apply across multiple materials; rate routings define continuous process flows; reference routings serve as templates.

attributes.name: scheduling_type
attributes.description: Scheduling strategy for this routing. Forward scheduling starts from the earliest start date; backward scheduling works back from the required finish date; midpoint scheduling balances around a target date.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this routing in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: standard_cost_amount
attributes.description: Standard cost to execute this routing for the base quantity. Includes labor, machine, overhead, and tooling costs. Used for cost accounting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Extended free-form text field for detailed routing notes, special handling instructions, safety warnings, and quality requirements.

attributes.name: total_labor_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total cumulative labor time in minutes across all operations for the base quantity. Labor time may scale differently than machine time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Work Center Capacity Planning

attributes.name: total_lead_time_hours
attributes.description: Total cumulative lead time in hours required to complete all operations in this routing for the base quantity. Includes setup, machine, labor, and queue times.
attributes.references: MRP (Material Requirements Planning) Lead Time Calculation

attributes.name: total_machine_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total cumulative machine processing time in minutes across all operations for the base quantity. Machine time scales with lot size.

attributes.name: total_operation_count
attributes.description: Total number of operations (steps) defined in this routing. Derived from routing operation line items.

attributes.name: total_setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total cumulative setup time in minutes across all operations for the base quantity. Setup time is independent of lot size.

attributes.name: usage
attributes.description: Intended application context for the routing. Standard routings are the default production method; alternative routings provide backup processes; trial routings support pilot runs; prototype routings support R&D; emergency routings address contingency scenarios.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this routing has been used in production orders or work orders. Indicates routing popularity and stability.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date from which this routing is valid and can be used in production planning and execution.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Effective end date after which this routing is no longer valid. Null indicates indefinite validity.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the routing. Supports versioning of routing definitions to track engineering changes and process improvements.

products.name: wip_lot
products.description: Work-in-progress (WIP) lot or batch tracking entity representing a discrete quantity of material currently being processed through the production routing. Captures lot number, material number, current operation, current work center, quantity in process, quantity completed, quantity scrapped, lot creation timestamp, and lot status (in-process, on-hold, completed, scrapped). Enables real-time WIP visibility, genealogy tracing, and shop floor material flow tracking. Sourced from MES lot tracking (e.g., Siemens Opcenter).

attributes.name: wip_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work-in-progress lot or batch. Primary key for the WIP lot tracking entity.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_bom_line. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Links WIP lot to its plant location for lot traceability and site‑specific quality control.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record representing the product or component being manufactured in this lot.

attributes.name: material_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_requirement. Business justification: WIP lots originate from material requirements; linking enables requirement fulfillment analysis and variance reporting in the WIP Requirement Traceability report.

attributes.name: order_line_id

attributes.name: parent_lot_wip_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent WIP lot if this lot was split or derived from another lot. Enables genealogy and traceability tracking.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_work_order. Business justification: A WIP lot is generated from a specific production work order; linking removes the ambiguous order number field.

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.revision. Business justification: Lot tracking must record the component revision to ensure traceability for quality investigations.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production routing defining the sequence of operations this lot must traverse.

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_run. Business justification: A WIP lot is created and tracked during a production run — the lot physically exists on the shop floor as part of an active production campaign. Linking wip_lot.production_run_id -> production_run ena

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: WIP lot tracking requires the SKU identifier for traceability, quality inspection, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: stock_location_id

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot actually completed all operations and was confirmed as finished. Null if lot is still in process.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch identifier for process industries where multiple lots may be grouped into a single batch for traceability or quality purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Pharmaceutical GMP Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: current_operation_sequence
attributes.description: Sequence number of the operation currently being performed on this lot within the routing. Used to track progress through the production process.

attributes.name: current_operation_start_timestamp

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: Quality inspection lot number assigned by the QM system if this WIP lot is subject to inspection. Links to quality inspection records.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this WIP lot record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: lot_creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this WIP lot record was created in the MES system, marking the start of lot tracking.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the lot or batch. Human-readable unique code used for tracking and traceability across the shop floor and in MES systems.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, APQP Advanced Product Quality Planning

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the WIP lot. Indicates whether the lot is released for production, actively in process, on hold, completed, scrapped, or cancelled.
attributes.references: MES Manufacturing Execution System, SAP PP Production Order Status

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this WIP lot that do not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: original_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number of the original lot if this is a rework or split lot. Maintains traceability to the source lot for genealogy purposes.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Production priority level assigned to this lot. Determines scheduling precedence and resource allocation on the shop floor.
attributes.references: APS Advanced Planning and Scheduling, MES Scheduling

attributes.name: production_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when physical production of this lot began at the first operation. Used for lead time and cycle time calculation.
attributes.references: MES Shop Floor Control, Lean Manufacturing Metrics

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Project identifier if this lot is being produced for a specific engineering or customer project. Used for project-based manufacturing tracking.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot requires quality inspection before proceeding to the next operation or before final goods receipt.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Management, APQP Advanced Product Quality Planning

attributes.name: quantity_completed
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of material that has successfully completed all operations in the routing and is ready for goods receipt.
attributes.references: SAP PP Goods Receipt, MES Production Reporting

attributes.name: quantity_in_process
attributes.description: Current quantity of material actively being processed at the current operation. Represents material that has not yet completed the current step.
attributes.references: MES Manufacturing Execution System, WIP Tracking

attributes.name: quantity_on_hold
attributes.description: Quantity of material in this lot that is currently on hold pending quality inspection, engineering review, or other disposition decision.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Management, NCR Non-Conformance Report

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Total quantity of material originally planned to be produced in this lot as specified in the production order.

attributes.name: quantity_scrapped
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of material that has been rejected or scrapped due to quality defects or process failures during production.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Management, SPC Statistical Process Control

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is a rework lot created to reprocess previously rejected or non-conforming material.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Management, CAPA Corrective and Preventive Action

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which this lot is scheduled to complete all operations and be available for goods receipt. Used for capacity planning and delivery commitment.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Scheduling, APS Advanced Planning and Scheduling

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code

attributes.name: serial_number_profile

attributes.name: shift_code

attributes.references: MES Shop Floor Control, OEE Overall Equipment Effectiveness

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating if this lot represents special stock such as consignment, project stock, or customer-owned material.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Management Special Stock

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields in this lot record (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, M for meters).
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, SAP Material Master UOM

products.name: bom_consumption

Tracks component material number, planned vs. actual issued quantity, variance quantity, unit of measure, storage location, batch number, and backflush indicator. Enables actual vs. planned BOM consumption variance analysis for cost control and material planning feedback. Sourced from ERP goods issue postings (e.g., SAP movement type 261) and MES backflush events.

attributes.name: bom_consumption_id
attributes.description: Primary key for bom_consumption

attributes.name: engineering_bom_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific BOM line item that defines the planned component requirement. Links actual consumption to engineering BOM specification.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality inspection lot if the component underwent inspection before consumption. Links consumption to quality control records.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the component material consumed from inventory. Identifies the specific raw material, sub-assembly, or component issued to production.

attributes.name: material_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_requirement. This is a core manufact

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent work order for which materials were consumed. Links consumption to the manufacturing execution context.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Material consumption entries need the SKU to roll up costs and efficiency metrics to the final product.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location or bin within the warehouse from which material was picked. Provides granular inventory tracking.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse from which the component material was issued. Identifies the physical storage facility.

attributes.name: wip_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.wip_lot. Business justification: bom_consumption records the actual goods issue of raw materials and components consumed during production. This consumption is directly tied to a specific WIP lot being processed — the lot that consum

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: The actual cost per unit of the component material based on moving average price or FIFO/LIFO valuation. Reflects real inventory valuation at consumption time.

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of component material issued from inventory to the work order. Represents the real consumption recorded via goods issue or backflush.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumption was automatically backflushed by the MES system upon work order confirmation (true) or manually posted (false).

attributes.name: consumption_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or special instructions related to the consumption event. Captures operator notes and exception details.

attributes.name: consumption_status
attributes.description: Current status of the consumption record: posted (finalized in ERP), pending (awaiting confirmation), reversed (cancelled), cancelled (voided), confirmed (validated by supervisor).

attributes.name: consumption_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consumption event: planned (per BOM), unplanned (ad-hoc issue), scrap (defective material), rework (reprocessing), or sample (quality testing).

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center to which the material consumption cost is allocated. Used for internal cost accounting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consumption record was first created in the data warehouse. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all cost amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY). Ensures consistent financial reporting across global operations.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration or shelf-life date of the consumed component material. Critical for perishable materials, chemicals, and time-sensitive components.

attributes.name: goods_issue_number
attributes.description: The ERP-generated document number for the material goods issue transaction. Typically corresponds to SAP movement type 261 for production consumption.

attributes.name: goods_issue_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the material goods issue transaction was posted in the ERP system. Represents the official consumption event time.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consumption record was last updated in the data warehouse. Tracks data change history for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Three-digit SAP movement type code indicating the nature of the goods issue. Common values: 261 (goods issue to order), 262 (reversal of 261).

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: The routing operation sequence number at which the component was consumed. Links consumption to the specific production step in the routing.

attributes.name: original_goods_issue_number
attributes.description: If this is a reversal transaction, the goods issue document number of the original transaction being reversed. Enables audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of component material planned to be consumed according to the BOM specification and work order quantity. Basis for variance analysis.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the consumption transaction was posted to the general ledger. May differ from goods issue timestamp for period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumed component required quality inspection before use (true) or not (false). Supports quality assurance compliance tracking.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for the consumption or variance. Examples: normal production, rework, quality testing, engineering change, process improvement.

attributes.name: reservation_item_number
attributes.description: The line item number within the material reservation document. Provides granular linkage to the specific reserved component.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: The ERP reservation document number that allocated the material to the work order. Links consumption to the material requirements planning reservation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents a reversal of a previous goods issue (true) or an original consumption posting (false). Used for correction and adjustment tracking.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of component material scrapped or wasted during production. Subset of actual quantity representing non-conforming or damaged material.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the component if serialized inventory control is used. Provides unit-level traceability for critical components.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: The shift during which the material was consumed (e.g., day shift, night shift, weekend shift). Supports shift-level performance analysis.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: The standard cost per unit of the component material at the time of consumption. Used for cost variance calculation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: The total cost of the consumption transaction (actual quantity multiplied by actual unit cost). Represents the financial impact of the material issue.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for all quantity fields (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, L for liters, M for meters). Must align with material master base UOM.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between actual and planned consumption quantity (actual minus planned). Positive values indicate over-consumption; negative values indicate under-consumption.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Specific code explaining the root cause of consumption variance when actual differs from planned. Used for continuous improvement and cost control analysis.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the work center or production resource where the component was consumed. Enables cost center allocation and capacity analysis.

Draft indicates work in progress, In Review means under engineering approval, Approved is ready for release, Active is in production use, Obsolete is no longer valid, Superseded has been replaced by a newer revision, and Frozen is locked for regulatory or contractual reasons. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|active|obsolete|superseded|frozen — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended business purpose. Engineering BOM (EBOM) represents design intent, Manufacturing BOM (MBOM) reflects shop floor assembly, Service BOM supports after-sales maintenance, Sales BOM defines customer-facing configurations, Planning BOM is used for MRP, and As-Maintained BOM tracks actual installed configurations.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the BOM structure. Material BOM lists physical components, Document BOM references technical drawings and specifications, Equipment BOM defines installed assets, Variant BOM supports product families, Configurable BOM enables customer-specific selections.

attributes.name: configuration_profile
attributes.description: Identifier for a variant configuration profile or product family definition. Used in configurable BOMs to define which components are included based on customer selections or feature options.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the BOM cost estimate. Supports multi-currency costing for global manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_total
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of the BOM including all material, labor, and overhead components. Rolled up from component costs and routing operations. Used for product costing and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was first created in the PLM system. Provides audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the BOM, providing additional context about the product structure, manufacturing method, or special handling requirements. Supplements the BOM number and type.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM revision becomes valid and can be used for production planning, procurement, and manufacturing execution. Supports time-phased BOM management for product transitions.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this BOM revision remains valid. Nullable for open-ended BOMs. Used to manage phase-out of legacy product structures and ensure correct BOM selection in MRP and MES systems.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: explosion_type
attributes.description: Defines how the BOM structure should be expanded for planning and execution. Single Level shows only immediate children, Multi Level recursively expands all sub-assemblies, Summarized aggregates quantities across all levels.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this BOM supports variant configuration, allowing customer-specific or order-specific component selection. True for configurable BOMs, False for fixed BOMs.

attributes.name: is_critical_bom
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this BOM is for a critical or high-value product requiring special handling, approval workflows, or regulatory compliance. True for critical BOMs, False for standard BOMs.

attributes.name: is_phantom_bom
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a phantom (transient) BOM that is not stocked as a discrete item but is exploded through to its components during MRP and production. True for phantom BOMs, False for standard stocked assemblies.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: lot_size
attributes.description: Standard production lot or batch size for which this BOM is optimized. Used in MRP calculations to determine component requirements and setup costs. Nullable if not applicable.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that last modified this BOM record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was last updated. Distinct from approval and effectivity dates. Provides audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or instructions related to this BOM. May include manufacturing guidelines, quality requirements, or special handling instructions for production planning and shop floor execution.

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Identifier linking this BOM to a specific production version in SAP PP, which combines a BOM with a routing to define a complete manufacturing process. Supports multiple production methods for the same product.

attributes.name: quantity_basis
attributes.description: The base quantity for which this BOM is defined, typically 1 for single-unit BOMs or a batch size for process manufacturing. All component quantities in the BOM structure are expressed relative to this basis.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: revision
attributes.description: Revision level or version identifier for this BOM structure. Tracks engineering changes and ensures traceability across ECO and ECN processes. Critical for change management and configuration control.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, APQP Advanced Product Quality Planning

attributes.name: scrap_percentage
attributes.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage at the BOM header level, applied to all components. Used in MRP to inflate material requirements. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: The primary key or unique identifier of this BOM record in the source system. Enables bidirectional traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational PLM system.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity basis, such as EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), M (meter). Must align with the PLM item and material master UOM definitions.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: usage
attributes.description: Defines the business context in which this BOM is intended to be used. Production for shop floor execution, Costing for standard cost calculation, Engineering for design and development, Maintenance for service and repair, Sales Order for customer-specific configurations, Project for one-time builds.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: weight_total
attributes.description: Total weight of the finished assembly including all components, calculated from the BOM structure. Used for logistics planning, freight cost estimation, and product specifications.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the total BOM weight. KG (kilogram), LB (pound), G (gram), OZ (ounce), MT (metric ton).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that originally created this BOM record. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

products.name: engineering_bom_line
products.description: Individual line item within a Bill of Materials, representing a single parent-child component relationship. Captures position number, find number, quantity per assembly, unit of measure, reference designator, substitute component references (approved alternates with qualification status and usage restrictions), phantom flag, effectivity start/end dates, and engineering notes. Enables full BOM explosion and implosion queries for MRP, supports alternate sourcing without ECO, and provides the granular structure for production routing and cost rollup.

attributes.name: engineering_bom_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM line item. Primary key for the BOM line entity representing a single parent-child component relationship within a bill of materials structure.

attributes.name: bom_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent BOM header that this line belongs to. Links the line item to its containing bill of materials assembly structure.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.bom. Business justification: bom_line represents a line item belonging to a BOM; adding bom_id creates the required parent-child relationship and eliminates the BOM silo.

attributes.name: eco_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: MRP explosion requires each BOM line to reference a material master directly for inventory requirements planning, stock reservation, and procurement triggering. Manufacturing planners use BOM line → m

attributes.name: primary_engineering_component_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent assembly or product that contains this component. Represents the 'parent' side of the parent-child relationship in the BOM structure.

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_revision. Business justification: A BOM line item is effective for a specific revision range of the parent assembly. Linking engineering_bom_line to engineering_revision (the specific revision at which this line was introduced or is v

attributes.name: tertiary_engineering_substitute_component_id
attributes.description: Reference to an approved alternate component that can be used in place of the primary component without requiring an Engineering Change Order (ECO). Enables flexible sourcing and supply chain continuity.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Alternate Parts Management

attributes.name: assembly_instruction
attributes.description: Specific instructions for assembling or installing this component into the parent assembly. May reference work instructions, torque specifications, or special tooling requirements.

attributes.name: bulk_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is a bulk material (e.g., paint, adhesive, lubricant) that is consumed in variable quantities and may not be tracked at individual unit level.

attributes.name: co_product_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line represents a co-product or by-product that is produced alongside the main assembly. Co-products have negative quantities in the BOM and represent outputs rather than inputs.

attributes.name: cost_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost of this component should be included in the parent assembly cost rollup calculation. Some components (e.g., reference items, tooling) may be excluded from product costing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: critical_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is critical to product functionality, safety, or regulatory compliance. Critical components may require additional quality controls, traceability, or supply chain management.

attributes.name: effectivity_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this component is no longer effective in the parent assembly. Used to manage engineering changes and phase-out of obsolete components. Null indicates the component is currently effective with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_number_end
attributes.description: The ending serial number of the parent assembly for which this component is effective. Null indicates the component remains effective for all subsequent serial numbers.

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_number_start
attributes.description: The starting serial number of the parent assembly for which this component is effective. Enables serial-number-based effectivity control for mid-production engineering changes.

attributes.name: effectivity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this component becomes effective in the parent assembly. Used to manage engineering changes and phase-in of new components without creating new BOM versions.

attributes.name: engineering_bom_line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM line. Indicates whether the component relationship is currently in use, pending approval, or has been superseded.

attributes.name: engineering_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from engineering regarding special assembly instructions, design considerations, quality requirements, or other technical information relevant to this component usage.

attributes.name: find_number
attributes.description: Reference designator or callout number used to locate this component on engineering drawings, assembly diagrams, and technical documentation. Also known as item number or balloon number.

attributes.name: fixed_quantity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component quantity is fixed regardless of parent assembly batch size. When true, the quantity does not scale with production order quantity (e.g., setup materials, tooling).

attributes.name: installation_point
attributes.description: The specific location or mounting point within the parent assembly where this component is installed. Used in assembly instructions and maintenance documentation.

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: The number of days before the parent assembly start date that this component must be available. Used in production scheduling and material requirements planning (MRP) to ensure timely component availability.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user or system account that last modified this BOM line record. Used for audit trail and change management purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: phantom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is a phantom (transient) assembly that is not stocked or tracked in inventory. Phantom items are exploded through to their child components during MRP processing.

attributes.name: position_number
attributes.description: Sequential position or line number of this component within the parent assembly BOM. Used for ordering and identifying components in engineering drawings and manufacturing instructions.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how this component is obtained: manufactured in-house (make), purchased from suppliers (buy), transferred from another plant (transfer), or subcontracted to external manufacturers.

attributes.name: quantity_per_assembly
attributes.description: The number of units of this component required to build one unit of the parent assembly. Used for material requirements planning (MRP) calculations and cost rollup.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Material Requirements Planning

attributes.name: reference_designator
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific location or function of the component in the assembly (e.g., R1, C5, U3 for electronics; A-01, B-12 for mechanical). Used in assembly instructions and maintenance documentation.
attributes.references: IPC Association Connecting Electronics Industries Standards

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: The revision or version of the component that is specified for use in this assembly. Ensures that the correct component revision is used for manufacturing and quality control.

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percentage
attributes.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage for this component during assembly or manufacturing. Used to adjust material requirements planning (MRP) calculations to account for normal production losses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Scrap Calculation

attributes.name: sort_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric value used to control the display order of BOM lines in reports, pick lists, and assembly instructions. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: substitute_qualification_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the substitute component for use in this assembly. Indicates whether the alternate has passed qualification testing and is approved for production use.

attributes.name: substitute_usage_restriction
attributes.description: Conditions or limitations on when the substitute component may be used (e.g., only for specific customer orders, only when primary is unavailable, geographic restrictions). Ensures proper alternate sourcing governance.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the component quantity is expressed (e.g., each, kilogram, meter, liter). Must align with the component material master UOM for accurate MRP and inventory calculations. attributes.description: The user or system account that created this BOM line record. Used for audit trail and change management purposes.

products.name: eco
products.description: Engineering Change Order — the formal governance record initiating, tracking, approving, and closing a controlled change to a released product design. Captures ECO number, change type (design, material, process), priority, reason code, affected items with disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap, retrofit), effectivity date, cost/schedule impact, initiator, approver chain, closure status, and revision transition (from/to). Includes affected item detail: item reference, type, current/proposed revision, disposition action, quantity affected, and implementation status per item. Upon approval, also serves as the Engineering Change Notice (ECN) — the formal communication record distributed to production, supply chain, quality, and supplier portals capturing notification distribution list, acknowledgement tracking, implementation date, and affected BOM/drawing revisions. SSOT for engineering change governance and change communication per ISO 9001 change control requirements.

products.name: eco_affected_item
products.description: This association product represents the formal linkage between an Engineering Change Order and each component it affects. It captures the specific disposition, effectivity, and revision transition for each component impacted by the ECO. Each record links one ECO to one affected component with attributes that exist only in the context of this change control relationship. This is the SSOT for ECO-component impact tracking per ISO 9001 change control requirements.. Existence Justification: In manufacturing PLM operations, an ECO formally lists multiple affected components (parts, assemblies, drawings), and each component can be affected by multiple ECOs over its lifecycle. The ECO Affected Item is a recognized business entity in all major PLM systems (Siemens Teamcenter, PTC Windchill, Dassault ENOVIA) that captures disposition instructions, effectivity dates, and revision transitions specific to each ECO-component pair. This relationship is actively managed by engineering teams as part of ISO 9001 change control processes.

products.name: ncr
products.description: Non-Conformance Report (NCR) serving as the single, unified quality event record for ALL deviations from specifications, standards, or requirements regardless of detection source or reporting channel. Encompasses internal defects, customer complaints (including 8D problem-solving), supplier non-conformances, field returns/RMA dispositions, and audit-triggered findings. Captures non-conformance type (internal/customer/supplier/field-return/audit), affected material/product/serial number, detection source (incoming inspection, in-process, final inspection, field/customer, audit, supplier delivery), severity classification, containment actions, root cause analysis, disposition decision (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return-to-supplier, repair, replace, credit, no-fault-found), RMA tracking fields (return authorization number, customer reference, repair actions, return shipment status), SAP QM notification type mapping (Q1/Q2/Q3), and linkage to CAPA for corrective/preventive action. Supports 8D methodology for customer-facing issues. Aligned with ISO 9001 clause 8.7 (control of nonconforming outputs), clause 10.2 (corrective action), and integrates with Salesforce Service Cloud for customer-originated events.

attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the CAPA record. Used for change detection in incremental data pipeline loads and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: lessons_learned

attributes.name: n8d_report_number

attributes.name: ppap_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA requires a new or revised Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submission due to process or design changes resulting from the corrective action. Relevant for automotive and industrial OEM supply chains.

tag_set.value: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Impact Flag

attributes.name: preventive_action_plan
attributes.description: Description of proactive actions planned to eliminate the causes of potential nonconformities before they occur. Addresses systemic risks identified during root cause analysis that may affect similar processes or products.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the CAPA based on risk severity, customer impact, regulatory exposure, or recurrence frequency. Drives escalation timelines and resource allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; FMEA Risk Priority Number (RPN)

attributes.name: problem_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nonconformity, defect, or quality event that triggered the CAPA. Includes observed symptoms, affected product or process, and initial impact assessment. Corresponds to the problem statement in the 8D or CAPA methodology.

attributes.name: quality_standard_reference
attributes.description: The specific quality standard clause, regulatory requirement, or customer specification that was violated or is being addressed by this CAPA. Examples: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.2, IATF 16949, customer-specific quality requirements.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA addresses a recurring nonconformity that has been previously reported. True if the same or similar root cause has been identified in a prior CAPA. Used for chronic problem identification and escalation.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA has regulatory reporting implications, such as mandatory notification to ISO certification bodies, OSHA, EPA, or CE/UL certification authorities. Triggers compliance escalation workflow when True.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; OSHA; EPA; CE Marking; UL

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_method
attributes.description: The structured methodology used to identify the root cause of the nonconformity. Common methods include 5-Why, Ishikawa (fishbone) diagram, 8D problem solving, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), fault tree analysis, or Pareto analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 5_why|ishikawa|8d|fmea|fault_tree|pareto|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause using the 6M Ishikawa framework: Man (human error), Machine (equipment), Material (raw material/component), Method (process/procedure), Measurement (inspection/calibration), or Environment (facility/conditions). Enables systemic trend analysis.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the identified root cause(s) of the nonconformity as determined through the root cause analysis. This is the foundational finding that drives the corrective action plan.

attributes.name: source_reference_number
attributes.description: The identifier of the originating document or record that triggered this CAPA, such as an NCR number, audit finding reference, customer complaint ticket number, or SAP QM notification number. Enables traceability back to the triggering event.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Category of the triggering event that initiated the CAPA. Indicates whether the CAPA originated from a Non-Conformance Report (NCR), customer complaint, internal or external audit finding, shop floor quality event, supplier quality issue, or regulatory inspection finding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ncr|customer_complaint|audit_finding|internal_quality_event|supplier_issue|regulatory_finding|field_failure|warranty_claim — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_closure_date
attributes.description: The planned date by which all corrective and preventive actions must be implemented and verified as effective. Used for on-time closure KPI tracking and escalation management.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the quality problem or improvement opportunity addressed by this CAPA. Used in dashboards, reports, and management reviews.
